versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Start on APIDot" section with key entry points for quick access from ClawHub.
- Removed the introductory file "skill-card.md".
- No changes made to feature scope or security rules.
- All major integration and usage guidance remain unchanged.

- Added references/api.md for local, non-executable API workflow notes.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md.
- Updated SKILL.md to mention references/api.md and clarify documentation-only scope.
- No executable code or network behavior added.

Initial release of the apidot-grok-imagine-api skill.

- Provides comprehensive documentation for integrating Grok Imagine APIs via APIDot, including image and video generation, async workflows, task polling, and webhook implementation.
- Contains only a detailed SKILL.md; no scripts, code, or executable files included.
- Outlines strict security guidelines for handling APIDOT_API_KEY and sensitive data.
- Offers clear routing to relevant APIDot model pages, docs, quickstarts, and example repos.
- Includes integration best practices and model-specific workflow guidance for Grok Imagine tasks.
